section_title: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting > Follow-up action when no SAR is filed

cards.title: Follow-up Actions When No SAR is Filed
cards.summary: After deciding not to file a SAR, document rationale, perform KYC review, reperform CRA if risk profile changes, update client file, and maintain ongoing monitoring.

flow_nodes.label: Decision not to file a SAR
flow_nodes.description: Triggering event: the decision not to file a SAR, requiring follow-up actions per internal procedures.
flow_nodes.source_quote: In cases where a SAR is not filed, organizations must still adhere to internal procedures... (v7u_N003588)

flow_nodes.label: Document rationale for not filing
flow_nodes.description: Document in detail: activity description, analysis steps, reasoning, and supporting documents.
flow_nodes.source_quote: Document the rationale for not filing a SAR in detail. (v7u_N003590)

flow_nodes.label: Conduct trigger-event KYC review
flow_nodes.description: Reassess customer's risk profile based on updated information, unusual transactions, negative news, or ownership changes.
flow_nodes.source_quote: A trigger-event KYC review should be conducted to reassess the customer's risk profile... (v7u_N003591)

flow_nodes.label: Document KYC review and actions
flow_nodes.description: Thoroughly document the KYC review and any actions taken.
flow_nodes.source_quote: Thoroughly document the review and actions taken. (v7u_N003592)

flow_nodes.label: Change in customer risk profile?
flow_nodes.description: Determine if there is a change in risk profile that would require CRA re-performance and mitigants.
flow_nodes.source_quote: ...if there is a change in the customer’s risk profile. (v7u_N003593)

flow_nodes.label: Reperform CRA and consider further risk mitigants
flow_nodes.description: Reperform customer risk assessment and consider additional risk mitigants. Document this process.
flow_nodes.source_quote: The customer’s CRA should be reperformed and further risk mitigants considered... This process should also be documented. (v7u_N003593, N003594)

flow_nodes.label: Update client file with investigation documentation
flow_nodes.description: Compile and update the client file with all investigation-related documents.
flow_nodes.source_quote: Additionally, update the client file with all investigation-related documentation. (v7u_N003595)

flow_nodes.label: Initiate/continue ongoing monitoring
flow_nodes.description: Ongoing monitoring to track customer activity for further unusual or suspicious behavior.
flow_nodes.source_quote: Ongoing monitoring should track customer activity for further unusual or suspicious behavior. (v7u_N003596)

flow_nodes.label: Accessible investigation records for future use
flow_nodes.description: Properly kept records that can be provided to regulators and law enforcement as needed.
flow_nodes.source_quote: Proper record keeping ensures that the organization can readily provide necessary information... (v7u_N003598)

cards.review_notes: Card extracted from descriptive follow-up actions. Sequence largely inferred from paragraph order; edges marked needs_review except explicit DECIDES yes and PRODUCES. Decision branch 'no' lacks direct evidence; reconstructed from process logic. No explicit end node due to ongoing nature.
